quickStart.title: Signum Mobile Wallet
quickStart.description: Set up your account to send and receive money using this awesome wallet!
quickStart.ctaTitle: Please make a selection to create or restore your account

createAccount.firstStepTitle: Before you create a new account, there's something you should be aware of...
createAccount.firstStepDescription: In Blockchain or Crypto, to fully own your new account, you must store securely your wallet's new secret phrase in a place you control. This ensures you can recover your wallet if needed
createAccount.firstStepPrimaryTermTitle: I understand that i am solely responsible for the security and backup of my wallets
createAccount.firstStepSecondaryTermTitle: I understand that if i ever lose access to my wallets, no one can help restore it
createAccount.firstStepThirdTermTitle: I understand that in the event of this application being transferred to a different device or being deleted, my funds can solely be retrieved using the secret phrase
createAccount.secondStepDescription: A secret phrase is a set of random words arranged in a specific order. It's like the main password for your wallet, and you can't change or choose it.
createAccount.secondStepSeedPhraseSecondTip: We do not store the secret phrase even on your device. Note it and always keep it private!. After backing up your secret phrase, you can use your wallet confidently, knowing it's safely saved
createAccount.enterSeedPhraseVerification: Now, confirm that you store the phrase by entering the requested word from your secret phrase
createAccount.verificationHint: Enter Word #{{word}} from your Secret Phrase
createAccount.walletNameHint: Please enter a name that you would like to use to identify this account
createAccount.accountCreatedDescription: Kindly hold on while the wallet prepares your account to use
createAccount.secretPhraseCreationDescription: It is very important that you store this Secret Phrase in a safe place. If you lose it, you will lose the access to your account. You need this Secret Phrase to import your account on other devices and/or alternative Signum Blockchain Wallets
createAccount.secretPhraseCreationSecondDescription: This account is part of the Signum Network, an advanced blockchain platform. You can use this Secret Phrase throughout the entire Signum eco-system, e.g. trade crypto tokens, create/buy NFTs and much more

importAccount.importDescription: Choose the type of the account
importAccount.importMnemonicHint: Import a Full account for making transactions. You'll need to provide a secret phrase or passphrase
importAccount.importWatchOnlyHint: Import a watch-only account for only supervising, you will not be able to make any transaction. You just view the account's transactions. This is a good security measure for wallets with a big amount of funds
importAccount.importWatchOnlySecondHint: You have the option to enter a Signum Wallet Address, account ID, or even aliases
importAccount.importAccountAlreadyExists: This account already exists on your wallet, please go to account settings and use it!
importAccount.importAccountResolvedAddressHint: Use this suggestion as a helpful tool to ensure you import the accurate account
